headline_stat.name: fraction of units with cosine-fit direction R²>0.3

justification.dataset: Dandiset 000129 (Sabes-lab macaque M1 self-paced reaching) is a canonical dataset for reach direction and velocity tuning, exactly appropriate for the phenomenon.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile with correct kinematic derivation, velocity smoothing, and movement-epoch thresholding, but all 130 units are used with no quality/inclusion filtering.
justification.analysis: Cosine fits with atan2 preferred directions and Spearman speed correlations are appropriate and the two independent methods agree (median 18°), but no shuffle/circular null is provided to establish the tuned-fraction thresholds.
justification.correctness: Reported numbers reproduce from the committed summary code and match the figures (R²=0.91 for unit 301, ~2.5x raster modulation, 18° cross-method offset), though computing R² and Spearman ρ on binned tuning-curve means inflates the reported fractions.
justification.figures: Figures are clear, labeled, give sample sizes, and select example units by effect strength (highest R² / |ρ|), which is the correct criterion; the effect is directly visible in the direction-quadrant PSTHs.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to a genuinely strong, internally validated result and nothing is contradicted by the figures, but the write-up omits explicit caveats (single subject/session, binning inflation), keeping it at 3 rather than 4.
justification.verdict: Core work is sound and the phenomenon is convincingly demonstrated; a reviewer would ask for a shuffle null and trial-level statistics plus a single-subject caveat before fully trusting the reported tuned-fraction numbers.
